# WP-003 review scope for PR #50

Only the following intentional behavioral delta is authorized:

- M1/M2/M3 manual confirmation authority moves from a local financial write to PAS authority.
- One real payment may produce at most one live authoritative confirmation.
- PAS unavailable means no local financial confirmation.
- A duplicate observation grants no additional credit.
- Manual review remains recovery and adjudication through PAS.

The following are explicitly not authorized:

- `/prinyat` selector semantic changes.
- Receipt amount or date editing invented by the implementation.
- OCR behavior changes.
- Date or calendar changes.
- Report or workday behavior changes.
- `approvedBy` regression.
- Automatic confirmation behavior changes.
- Deployment or cutover.
- Migration.
- Production topology assumptions.
